# Matic Reconcile
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: verify the current claim owner, reconcile every affected carrier, and preserve the claim token before Measure.

## Purpose

Align the completed implementation, run evidence, documentation, tests, deployment guidance, and relevant PM Control records without changing unrelated project records.

## Trigger

Run after Build completes and before Measure. Run again after a quality correction changes an affected carrier.

Do not run when Build is blocked, the changed paths are unknown, or the plan-control boundary is missing.

## Interface Contract

```text
Build handoff + execution plan + changed files + current controls -> reconcile affected carriers and evidence -> reconciliation record and updated carriers
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/execution-plan.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/plan-control-record.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/01-define/`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/02-design/`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/03-build/build-handoff.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md`, the current remote claim record and execution ID, `workspace/matic-workflow/claim-contract.md`, changed source and test paths named by Build, relevant `pm-control/registers/`, and affected project or operations documentation |
| Transform | Compare intended and actual change carriers, correct stale affected records, and verify traceability before quality measurement |
| Outputs | `reconciliation-record.md`, updated affected carriers, and `run-state.md` |

## Input Gate

- Confirm Build handoff exists and lists changed files, tests, limitations, and rollback.
- Confirm the plan and acceptance matrix identify the issue title and scope.
- Confirm all changed source and documentation paths are inspectable.
- Confirm relevant PM Control records are available.
- Confirm the remote claim still belongs to this run and the authenticated operator holds its active execution ID.
- Recheck the claim immediately before changing any affected carrier. Stop on contention or a stale token.
- Stop with `Blocked` if reconciliation cannot identify the correct source of truth.

## Transform

1. Verify the current claim and execution token.
2. Compare the plan, Build handoff, Git diff, source, tests, documentation, deployment guidance, and relevant PM Control records.
3. Update only affected carriers so they agree on scope, status, evidence, owner, open gates, and next route.
4. Preserve unresolved browser, staging, operations, launch, and human-decision gaps.
5. Record every changed carrier, unchanged carrier, discrepancy, correction, and evidence path.
6. Verify no stale pre-change statement remains in an affected carrier.
7. Append a verified claim transition that records Reconcile completion and the Measure route.

## Outputs

| Output | Location | Format | Intended consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reconciliation record | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/04-reconcile/reconciliation-record.md` | Markdown | Measure and PM Control review |
| Affected carriers | Exact files identified by the plan and Build handoff | Existing format | Project and application consumers |
| Run state | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Markdown | Router and resume flow |
| Claim state | `refs/heads/matic-claims/issue-<number>` | Git commit history | All operators and later stages |

## Verify

- Every changed file is listed and traceable to the issue.
- Relevant PM Control records agree with the implementation state and evidence.
- No unrelated register or source file was changed.
- The reconciliation write was authorized by the current claim execution ID.
- The reconciliation record names the next route as Measure.
- The claim history records the transition to the Measure route.
- A failed consistency check blocks downstream work.

## Review Gate

None unless reconciliation exposes a new scope, privacy, provider, production, or irreversible decision. In that case set `Blocked` and route to Plan and Control.
